outcome: need for other drugs to control haemorrhage
cohort: The study comprised 120 women who underwent lower segment caesarean section at full-term pregnancy and had risk factors for experiencing postpartum haemorrhage.
finding: Misoprostol in conjunction with oxytocin was found to be more effective in reducing blood loss and other indicators of postpartum haemorrhage compared to oxytocin monotherapy.
mod_finding: The study found that combined therapy was more effective for prophylaxis of postpartum haemorrhage in women undergoing lower segment caesarean section.
gest_age: full-term pregnancy (mean gestational age 38.02 weeks in group A, 37.50 weeks in group B)
